text: Just sharing the timeline: we (the Israeli spouse) walked into MH last December, after sending email and not receiving responses, to request an invite. A January appointment was given to submit the document for request and then we only received the invite from MH last week. War definitely didn't help but even without, the length of this simple process is absurd. I'm honestly considering dropping the idea of having family visit because it's just not worth all of the effort.
